title: Feather Boosted
description: This Modpack is Best For Fps Boost
body:
# **🪶 Feather Boosted**
A performance-first Fabric modpack for Minecraft 1.21 to 26.2 — massive FPS gains, shader support, cosmetics, and proximity voice chat, all pre-configured and ready to play.
Feather Boosted combines every major performance mod available for 1.21 with a carefully curated set of visual enhancements, cosmetic upgrades, and social features. Whether you're playing solo or on a server with friends, this pack gets you smoother gameplay without sacrificing the features that make multiplayer fun.
## 
## ⚡ Performance
Every significant Fabric performance mod is included and pre-tuned:

- Sodium — Complete rendering engine replacement with massive FPS uplift
- Sodium Extra — Additional fine-grained rendering settings
- Lithium — Broad game logic and server-side optimizations
- C2ME — Multithreaded chunk generation for faster world loading
- Krypton — Optimized networking stack for reduced latency
- ModernFix — Fixes dozens of vanilla performance bugs, improves startup time and memory usage
- FerriteCore — Significant RAM reduction through memory deduplication
- ImmediatelyFast — Batches immediate-mode rendering for GPU efficiency
- EntityCulling — Asynchronously skips rendering entities you can't see
- MoreCulling — Additional culling for block faces and foliage
- BadOptimizations — Collection of small but impactful micro-optimizations
- Dynamic FPS — Drops to minimal FPS when the window is unfocused to save resources
- Clumps — Merges XP orbs into single entities to prevent lag spikes
- Indium — Ensures Fabric Rendering API mods stay compatible with Sodium

## 
## 🎨 Visuals & Shader Support

- Iris — Full shader pack support, compatible with most OptiFine shaders. No shader is bundled — - drop your favourite into the shaderpacks folder and enable it in-game
- Entity Model Features (EMF) — OptiFine-compatible custom entity models
- Entity Texture Features (ETF) — Random/custom entity textures, emissives, and more
- SkinLayers3D — Renders the outer skin layer in 3D for a more detailed player model
- WaveyCapes — Physics-simulated capes with smooth, realistic movement
- Capes — Displays OptiFine, LabyMod, MinecraftCapes, and other capes
- ModelFix — Eliminates the bright pixel artifacts that appear on certain block models
- BrightnessPlus — Extends the brightness slider beyond vanilla limits


## 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Social & Multiplayer

- Chat Heads — Shows player heads next to their messages in chat
MoreChatHistory — Dramatically increases chat scroll-back so you never lose context


## 🛠️ Quality of Life

- ApplesKin — Shows hunger and saturation values on food tooltips and the HUD
- ZoomX — Smooth, configurable zoom keybind (no OptiFine needed)
- Mouse Tweaks — Drag-to-fill, scroll-to-fill, and other inventory improvements
- ModMenu — In-game mod list with direct links to each mod's config screen


## 🎒 Bundled Resource Packs

- Amazing Mace 3D — Gives the Mace weapon a proper 3D model in first and third person
- Spunky Pack Classic — Clean GUI and texture refinements
